_README: Host profile for running workers on your own machine. Replace each <...> with an absolute path (the render refuses a placeholder) and pass the file to runtime/render/render.py --host, with --out set to paths.bundle. Run one worker with `python3 <bundle>/scripts/runtime/run_worker.py <worker>`; factory-setup/references/hosting-local.md says how to schedule it.
name: local
_env: The variables a run keeps from the shell or scheduler that starts it; everything else is dropped. Add what the board and publishing configs name and what the repo's build reads.
